items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: One band had a piano, and I used to... Toots Johnson's band.

ctx.x: We jumped a little there, because we jumped to you on clarinet. So let me go back a little. So you started being interested in the piano.
I started the piano. I had a neighbor that had one of these player pianos that played rolls,
player piano rolls. I liked the sound of that, so I started fiddling with it. Well, naturally, a few bands in Baton Rouge... One band had a piano, and I used to... Toots Johnson's band.
